text:
Nate: heads-up 1 I'm proposing a doc correction: the model catalog currently lists 'Nebula3b' as supporting "live-quant" profiles but the runtime team says only `nebula3b-quant-v1` is verified for dedicated. planning PR with: corrected support table, a short note in compatibility, and an SDK snippet showing `model: 'nebula3b-quant-v1'`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4600
Priya: important fix. customers have been confused when they try generic nebula3b with quant flags. can you add the compatibility footnote about cold-starts and the recommended default of `precision: 'int8'`?
Lena: also add a redirect from the old doc anchor that mentioned 'live-quant' to the new doc. i can handle link redirects.
Nate: ok adding: "Note: only nebula3b-quant-v1 is validated for dedicated and private due to kernel compatibility. Other quant variants may work but are unsupported."
Priya: please include an example python snippet for toggling precision in the SDK: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = rc.generate.create(model='nebula3b-quant-v1', input='hello', runtime_options={'precision':'int8'})
print(resp.output)
```
Lena: linking to the runtime compatibility matrix (internal) would help engineers. drop the link in a hidden comment in PR.
build-bot: CI started for PR #4600: lint, linkcheck, and unit-snippet tests queued.
Nate: added the corrected table row, a small bench note comparing nebula3b vs nebula3b-quant-v1 (p50 delta ~7ms), and the snippet.
Priya: lgtm with one nit: change 'unsupported' to 'not verified' so customers aren't scared.
Nate: changed wording to 'not verified'. thanks.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4600. snippet runner OK. linkcheck found unrelated stale anchor in /docs/old-quant-walkthrough.
Nate: merged. will follow up with a short slack announcement in #docs and #eng-ml. closing thread. :rocket:
